relationships.subject: Synaptic vesicle endocytosis
relationships.evidence_quote: We identified SV endocytosis in nociceptors as a critical driver of ongoing pain

relationships.subject: AAK1
relationships.evidence_quote: AAK1 or Dnm1 downregulation blocked the sustained synaptic transmission between nociceptors and dorsal horn neurons by disrupting SV recycling and reducing neurotransmitter release probability

relationships.subject: Dnm1
relationships.evidence_quote: knockdown of adaptor-associated kinase 1 (AAK1) or dynamin 1 (Dnm1) in dorsal root ganglia Nav1.8-positive neurons inhibited postoperative and neuropathic hypersensitivity

key_findings: Nociceptor-specific AAK1 or Dnm1 knockdown relieves postoperative and neuropathic pain without altering baseline sensation.
LNP-delivered dCas9 repressors against Aak1/Dnm1 give durable analgesia across pain models.
